description: He wears a blue-green crossed-front knee-length deel over a light long-sleeved underlayer. Gold geometric and cloud-patterned borders decorate the collar, crossing edge, cuffs and hem. A brown wrapped sash has round metal ornaments and hanging fringed ends. Dark fitted forearm coverings have embroidered textile patterns. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit; his head is bare.
